title: Application Security & OWASP
intro: Application security interview questions cover the OWASP top issues every senior backend engineer is expected to know — injection (SQL, command), broken authentication and session management, XSS and CSRF, insecure deserialization, dependency vulnerabilities (CVE triage, Log4Shell-grade incidents), secrets management, secure password storage (bcrypt/argon2), TLS basics, and the secure-by-default patterns in modern Spring Boot. Pair this with the Spring Security page for the auth-specific surface.
